work.name: HolyPoly
work.summary: Responsible for corporate IT: strategy, infrastructure, services, software development, operations and security
highlights: Built and led a 5-member remote IT team from the ground up, with high resilience and self-sufficiency by maximising the psychological safety.
Led the continuous optimization of development and operational methodologies, reducing team cycle time by 50% while maintaining high service quality.

Designed software architecture for multinational toy and baby product companies to integrate complex reverse logistics into their websites and streamline the check-in of recycled parcels for batch tracing.

Introduced ERPNext as an open-source ERP, streamlining business processes, reducing application/data fragmentation, and enabling cloud-native deployments in minutes instead of hours for faster process integration.

Developed a Bluetooth-WebSocket bridge for a handheld XRF device by reverse-engineering, accelerating inorganic impurity detection in recyclable plastic products by 200% empowering clients to make data-driven decisions for reuse of plastics from millions of data points.

Established an IT security baseline to ensure global compliance and enable enterprise revenue, while leading the ongoing development of an ISMS for enhanced data protection and business customer assurance.

work.name: Startnext
work.summary: Operations of the crowdfunding platform infrastructure
highlights: Transformed the legacy PHP crowdfunding plattform to a container-based infrastructure, enabling horizontal scaling, seamless CI/CD roll-outs, improved QA, developer/user experience, and faster platform updates.
Migrated crowdfunding platform storage from NFS to Ceph, enabling concurrent R/W access, horizontal scaling and seamless platform code roll-out.

Redesigned the monitoring stack using Telegraf, Loki, InfluxDB, Alertmanager, and Grafana. Leading to reduced operational costs and improved monitoring efficacy while also providing better business intelligence capabilities.

work.name: Coinboot
work.summary: Created Coinboot, an Open Source framework for diskless GPU computing clusters (Video of conference talk)

Engineered a lightweight (105 MB) network-bootable diskless Linux image optimized for scalability. Allowing Coinboot to run effectively on thousands of nodes using standard 1 Gbit/s network hardware.
Created a user-friendly plugin system for customization and different computing workloads without rebuilding the boot image.

Automated Ceph deployment as a unified OpenStack storage backend, replacing Swift and GlusterFS. Successfully scaled to petabytes, optimizing for heterogeneous disk/rack configurations while reducing complexity and boosting performance.
Developing an automated system monitoring in highly-distributed micro datacenters with waste heat reuse.
